title: Support request form: topic, order number, message, attachments, priority — Voltaic Home
notes: v1 is a Foundation 6 page (grid-x/cell, labels wrapping inputs, ticket[...] names). v2 is a React + MUI v5 rebuild: MuiTextField/MuiSelect markup with css-xxxxxxx emotion classes and ':r5:' ids, notched-outline <legend><span> copies of every label, the topic select becomes a role=combobox div with a hidden native input, the description gets MUI's hidden autosize <textarea> twin, and fields are regrouped (product/topic first, contact details last, priority before attachments, priorities reordered with 'High' added). Decoys: a new 'Product' combobox, a 'Popular answers' card repeating the order-number help link, a hidden MUI dialog with a second 'Submit request' button, and a <vh-support-chat> widget (declarative shadow root) with its own textarea and send button.
